title: Know the supported boundary and fetch recovery
when: Publishing a fork build or resolving relay_release_fetch_failed
need: Operator supplies compatible immutable installer/channel/wheels/index/image. Relay needs the server exact immutable version, not another channel guess. Upstream hosted publishing and automatic fork/migration governance are outside this contract.
surface: Private forks guide -> artifact requirements, relay status recovery and Unsupported at this level.
